x-semantics: Open source-evidence tasks for capabilities whose production adapter must not be guessed. A task is not a promise that the capability is available; it records exactly what evidence is missing.

x-unknown-values.null_meaning: not yet verified; the capability remains blocked or limited

tasks.question: Which official source exposes a student's personal timetable with a stable term, course, week-pattern, room and occurrence identity?
known_evidence: The registrar teaching calendar via Learn SSO returns nq/kssj/jssj/nr/dd/fl rows.
The same adapter explicitly says its scope is a selected registrar teaching calendar and not all teaching or exam arrangements.
tasks.evidence_role: ABSENCE_OR_SCOPE_ONLY: the calendar proves what the existing adapter does not cover; it is not a timetable source.
missing_evidence: Official endpoint or page for the personal timetable.
Term identifier, course identifier and week/period semantics.
Room and occurrence identity.
Read permission and completeness scope.
forbidden_inferences: Do not derive a personal timetable from the registrar teaching calendar.
Do not infer a course or week from a title or array position.
Do not guess an endpoint from an unrelated page.
tasks.next_action: Have the authorized local owner capture the official timetable page structure and field inventory, then store only sanitized field names, synthetic samples and summary hashes.
tasks.blocking_reason: No verified timetable source or field mapping exists.

tasks.question: Which official source exposes exam session, date, time, room, seat and release state for the current student?
known_evidence: The registrar teaching calendar is explicitly not a complete exam source.
No exam parser, endpoint or fixture exists in the repository.
tasks.evidence_role: ABSENCE_OR_SCOPE_ONLY: the calendar proves what the existing adapter does not cover; it is not an exam source.
missing_evidence: Official exam endpoint or page.
Exam identifier, course association and date/time precision.
Room/seat and release or cancellation state.
Completeness and permission semantics.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer exams from the teaching calendar.
Do not pad a date-only exam to midnight.
Do not treat a missing exam row as no exam.
tasks.next_action: Collect a sanitized exam field inventory from the authorized local owner; keep raw responses out of the repository.
tasks.blocking_reason: No verified exam source or result shape exists.

tasks.question: Which official source exposes course grades with semester, course identity, grade scale, credits and publication state?
known_evidence: Assignment grade fields exist in the Learn read adapter, but they are assignment-level and not course grades.
No course-grade endpoint, parser or schema instance exists.
missing_evidence: Official course-grade source.
Course and semester identifiers that join to a stable course record.
Grade scale, credits and publication/withheld state.
Whether a missing value means unpublished, withheld or not applicable.
forbidden_inferences: Do not convert a missing grade to zero.
Do not compute GPA, rank or credit totals from incomplete data.
Do not treat assignment grades as course grades.
tasks.next_action: Collect a sanitized course-grade field inventory and define the grade-v1 sample against it; no real transcript export in the repository.
tasks.blocking_reason: No verified course-grade source or publication semantics exist.

tasks.question: What are the official upload, draft-save, final-submit, version-overwrite and result-query boundaries?
known_evidence: Assignment lists and details are read-only.
The local core has file validation and a preparation path, but no verified campus upload or final submit.
No draft-save or result-query endpoint is registered.
The 5.3 boundary (plan, ordered upload/draft/submit, stage machine, result check) is implemented with a declared-synthetic transport only.
missing_evidence: Upload endpoint and multipart/field contract.
Draft-save versus final-submit endpoints and their distinct responses.
Version overwrite semantics and server-side receipt.
Result-query endpoint and exact status fields.
Permission and deadline rules.
forbidden_inferences: A successful upload is not a saved draft.
A saved draft is not a final submission.
A local preparation is not a campus write.
An uncertain submit must never be replayed automatically.
tasks.next_action: Inspect the official form and response shapes without submitting a real assignment; record synthetic fixtures and a precise host-authorization requirement.
tasks.blocking_reason: Only read-side assignment support exists; write endpoints and result semantics are unverified.

tasks.question: What distinguishes renewal eligibility, execution acceptance, execution failure and the new due date?
known_evidence: Active loans expose renew=Y/N and renewal_hints text.
No renewal execution endpoint, success receipt or new-due-date read is implemented.
missing_evidence: Renewal execution endpoint and exact request body.
Success, rejection and failure response semantics.
New due date and revision/version fields.
Eligibility rules and account restrictions.
forbidden_inferences: An eligible hint is not a successful renewal.
Do not change the due date before an execution result is verified.
Do not retry an uncertain renewal automatically.
tasks.next_action: Collect sanitized renewal form and result shapes without clicking renew; define the renewal-v1 acceptance fixture with a failed execution and unchanged due date.
tasks.blocking_reason: Eligibility hints exist; execution and result semantics do not.

tasks.question: Does the current authenticated madmodel proxy accept image content, and if so in what request shape and under which model/limits?
known_evidence: The official catalog exposes a supportImage boolean and lists models with availability LISTED_NOT_PROBED.
The current generation payload is text-only.
missing_evidence: Actual image content-part or media request shape.
Which catalog models accept images through the current proxy.
Media byte, pixel and count limits enforced by the platform.
Response shape and error semantics for rejected images.
forbidden_inferences: Catalog supportImage=true does not prove the proxy can transport images.
Do not probe by sending a personal image.
Do not mark image input AVAILABLE until the protocol is verified.
tasks.next_action: Use official documentation or a synthetic image probe authorized by the owner; otherwise keep capability_state=UNVERIFIED and implement only local media validation.
tasks.blocking_reason: The catalog flag and the actual transport protocol are different evidence axes.

tasks.question: What is the current official visitor form contract, permission model and result state?
known_evidence: Only an official entry URL is registered.
No visitor adapter, form parser or result fixture exists.
missing_evidence: Current form fields and validation rules.
Account permission and approval flow.
Submission result, cancellation and status query semantics.
forbidden_inferences: Seeing a form is not an implemented adapter.
Do not submit a real visitor application to create evidence.
tasks.next_action: Keep the generic browser handoff; collect official form documentation if the capability is later prioritized.
tasks.blocking_reason: The form contract and permission model are not verified.

tasks.question: What is the exact scope and status semantics of the registrar teaching calendar exposed through Learn SSO?
known_evidence: The adapter reads 27-day windows and requires nq/kssj/jssj/nr.
It labels the scope as a selected registrar teaching calendar, not all teaching or exam arrangements.
missing_evidence: Whether every returned row is a class session, an exam or another teaching arrangement.
The meaning of the fl field.
Coverage across terms and graduate/undergraduate variants.
forbidden_inferences: Do not map fl directly to calendar-event status.
Do not treat this calendar as a full timetable or exam schedule.
tasks.next_action: Use only the verified nq/kssj/jssj/nr/dd fields for event projection and keep fl source-only; document the scope warning in every result.
